name: Open Link With
tagline: Choose which app opens your links, every time
description:
Open Link With solves a small but annoying problem: your phone always opens links in the same app, even when you'd rather use a different one. This app adds a quick menu so you can send any webpage straight to the browser or app you actually want.

It works from any app that shares a link, giving you a simple 'open with' choice instead of being stuck with one default.
